install.title: Install Docker and Amnezia
install.running: Installing, usually takes a few minutes. You can close the page — the job will continue.
install.previousFailed: The previous installation failed — the reason is in the jobs log below.
install.locked: Available once the key is pinned and SSH access is set.

protocol.title: Install AmneziaWG
protocol.lockedNoAccess: Available once the key is pinned and SSH access is set — the protocol is installed over SSH.
protocol.appV1: AmneziaVPN is already installed on this server (container {{container}}). The app owns that name, so the panel's own protocol cannot be installed here. You can take over the app's clients in the "AmneziaVPN is already on this server" block below.
protocol.appV2: AmneziaVPN with the AWG 2.0 protocol is already installed on this server (container {{container}}). The panel's protocol goes into a separate container and leaves the app alone, but make sure you need both installations.

panelKey.switchTitle: Switch to signing in with the panel key?
panelKey.renewConsequences: The panel will create a new key, check that signing in with it works and then remove the old one from the server. If the server doesn't accept the new key, the old one stays.
panelKey.switchConsequences: The panel will sign in with the current access, install its own key on the server and, once the login is verified, use only that key. The saved password or key in the panel will be replaced. Your own keys in authorized_keys are not changed.

removeProtocol.title: Remove AmneziaWG from the server?
removeProtocol.consequences: The protocol container and its settings will be deleted from the server and the port will close. While the server has live clients, the protocol can't be removed — revoke their access first.

deleteAccess.title: Delete SSH access to the server?
deleteAccess.consequences: The panel will stop connecting to the server: checks, sync, and issuing and revoking clients will stop until access is set again. The server itself and its clients keep working.

resetKey.title: Reset the pinned key?
resetKey.consequences: The panel will forget the server key, and password sign-in will be impossible until the key is checked and pinned again. Needed only if the server was reinstalled and its key changed.

deleteServer.title: Delete server “{{name}}”?
deleteServer.consequences: The server will disappear from the panel along with its SSH access and pinned key. Nothing changes on the server itself. It can't be deleted while it has live clients.

hostKey.title: Pin the server key
hostKey.description: The panel will remember the server key and connect only to it from now on. This keeps the password from going to a spoofed server.
hostKey.fingerprint: Fingerprint of the key the server presented
hostKey.mismatch: The key differs from the pinned one ({{fingerprint}}). Pin the new one only if you know the server was reinstalled.
hostKey.verify: Check it against the hosting console. On the server run ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub — the fingerprint must match exactly.

errors.noAnswer: The server didn't answer on the SSH port. Check the address, the port and that the server is on.

credentials.title: SSH access to the server
credentials.description: The panel stores the secret encrypted and uses it only to connect to this server.
credentials.replacePassword: Replace the password with the panel key
credentials.replaceHint: The panel will sign in with the password once, install its own key on the server and use that key from then on. The password won't stay in the panel.
credentials.privateKey: Private key (OpenSSH or PEM, no passphrase)

errors.panelKeyConflict: Can't install the key: pin the server key first, or a key installation is already running.
errors.panelKeyInvalid: Check the data: the user must be Latin letters without spaces.
errors.credentialInvalid: Check the data: the user must be Latin letters without spaces, and the key must be complete and without a passphrase.

jobsLog.empty: There have been no jobs for this server yet.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.empty: No samples for this period. The panel takes them once a minute over SSH — the first ones appear soon after the worker starts; an unreachable server leaves gaps.
monitoring.hourlyNote: Hourly averages; the summary is for the last hour.

discovery.title: AmneziaVPN is already on this server
discovery.description: The panel found an installation of the AmneziaVPN app. Its clients can be taken over by the panel: working configs stay as they are, while the access term and revocation move to the panel. The installation itself is not changed.
discovery.stoppedHint: The container is stopped, so taking over clients may fail.
discovery.nothingNew: Nothing to take over: there are no new clients. Create a client in the AmneziaVPN app and search again.

import.title: Take over AmneziaVPN clients
import.description: Choose the app clients to add to the panel. For each one the panel creates a user and access to this server.
import.warning: Clients' working configs do not change. The panel cannot show a config or QR code: the private key exists only in the client's app. When the term ends, the panel revokes access and removes the client from the server. While clients are in the panel, do not manage them in the AmneziaVPN app.
import.validUntilHint: The last day of access for all selected clients.

why.in_panel: This client is already in the panel, there is no need to take it over again.
why.unsupported: The panel takes over only clients with a single IPv4 address; this one has a different address.

problems.tooMany: At most {{max}} clients can be taken over at once.
problems.date: Enter the last day of access: tomorrow at the earliest and no more than 10 years ahead.
problems.username: Name: 1 to 100 characters, no control characters.
problems.email: Enter a full email such as name@example.com, or leave it empty.
problems.emailDuplicate: This email is already used for another client.
problems.summary: There are errors in {{count}} fields. Fix them and submit again.

errors.notFound: Server not found — it may have been deleted.
errors.conflict: The takeover was not queued: one is already running on the server, SSH access is not set, or the client is no longer in the latest discovery report. Find existing Amnezia again and retry.
errors.invalid: Check the data: names up to 100 characters, a full email, a term in the future.

import.failedNoText: The takeover failed. See the jobs log for details.

result.conflict: Not taken over because of conflicts: {{count}}

reasons.userHasAccess: The user already has access to this server and protocol.
reasons.emailTaken: A user with this email already exists.
reasons.notInEffect: The user's access term is not in effect now.
reasons.inPast: The access term is already in the past.

import.limit: At most {{max}} clients can be taken over at once. The first ones are selected; take over the rest in a separate run.
